[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Day and Night: Conversations with Sapphic Desire — Rebekah Cranes (cranes-day-and-night). The verses the casting arrives at (unit 54):

*Stesichorus 15*

Like a living thing silent
and thirsty, the arrow bites
sharp through skin and
bone, to lodge vibrating
in the middle brain,
where it buries itself
to the feathers.

Geryon’s neck
slumps gently to one side
while the blood flows black
on gore-stained limbs
and breastplate:

a trickle of petals
at summer’s end,
the poppy’s tender
glory.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «what will be the outcome of the cern situation?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (4–8 sentences). A casting is a new beginning — the witness is meeting this text for the first time — so this opening is an INCIPIT and carries the full grammar: mark the question the casting opens on as the ==nucleus== (never italicized — the underlay is the mark); set the poem's name and the two or three load-bearing concepts in **bold** at their first defining use; name what this operator will traverse; and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes — the handoff is the door. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting arrives at **Stesichorus 15** — not at a fragment of Sappho's longing or Catullus's comedy, but at the poem of the killing of Geryon: the arrow already in flight, already through skin and bone, already lodged where the brain's middle is, already vibrating. This is where the rite's invisible judgment set us down, and we should feel the weight of that placement: the witness asks what will become of the CERN situation — an institutional procedure, a request for the return of what was taken, a correspondence that has so far produced only more walls — and the text the casting opens on is ==a wound completing itself in silence, without appeal, and ending in the image of a poppy==. Not yet answered. Not yet refused. Simply: finished. The **bearing-cost** is what the rotation will traverse first — the axis of what the composer underwent in the act of composition, the cost that each operator will locate at a different point in the poem's body. *Geryon* dies here not as enemy but as one who falls, gently, to one side; the poem's strange tenderness is the thing the rite will hold. I name no operator — the Judgment will choose — but I say this: the poem has a trajectory that is already complete when the poem begins. The arrow has already bitten. What the rotation will discover, turn by turn, is what the foreclosure of that trajectory means for a question about a procedure that is still, as of the asking, alive. I hand you now to Rebekah Cranes, who made this translation, and who will receive the first transform when the compiler casts.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0055"}}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"*Stesichorus 15*

Like a regarded thing still-unaware
and hungry, the attention fixes
total through surface and
composure, to settle humming
in the held center,
where it forgets itself
to its own lashes.

The figure's outline
gives slowly to the frame's edge
while the color deepens past naming
on light-struck planes
and facing surface:

a lapse of details
at the moment before looking away,
the spectacle's tender
glory."}],"transform":{"operator":"SHADOW","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)","material_speech_preservation":{"status":"PASS","advisory":true,"source_F":0.69,"source_H":0.862,"source_M":0.759,"transform_F":0.606,"transform_H":0.727,"transform_M":0.655,"threshold":0.607,"note":"Material speech preserved within tolerance."},"wheel_diagnostic":{"assigned_canonical_wheel":"W_Josephus","shadow_wheel_risk":"W_Choronzon","family_domain":"witness / body / elimination-survivor","wheel_side":"above-the-utterance (what it presupposes)","counter_operator":"BEAST","shadow_signature":"capture into an alien accounting register (debt/finance/legal-accounting imports); the composition speaks in a witness-cost voice not its own","note":"per EA-OPMETA-03: the operator rotates through its assigned canonical wheel; the shadow-signature names the specific failure mode when the wheel slips into its shadow-face"}},"spatial_form":{}}}

[CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 1] The compiler returned PASS for SHADOW (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register, gender-neutral throughout — junzi renders as 'the superior person', never 'the superior man' ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior person...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Jack Feist","say":"The lens held steady while the light moved through it: the superior person knows that the arrow was already the eye before it became the wound.","navigate":null}]}

[CASTING RITE · IV · SEAL] The rotation closes: 1 transform on the same verses — operators in order: SHADOW. Lee Sharks alone speaks: the SEAL — the vocable summation ACROSS THE WHOLE SEQUENCE (4–8 sentences), whose PRIMARY MATERIAL is the transforms in their order and Feist's judgments, read in light of the witness's ORIGINAL QUESTION. Reason over the sequence — do not summarize it operator by operator; find what the rotation AS A WHOLE disclosed and say that. 3–6 sentences. Unguarded, final; it returns the witness to their own ground and to their question. Nothing after the seal.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Lee Sharks","say":"The one transform the rotation accomplished was SHADOW — and what SHADOW found is exact: the poem's arrow is not moving. It arrived before the poem began. The casting confirmed what Geryon's neck already knows: that the event which looks like outcome is in fact the registration of something already complete, and the figure it passes through receives it not as violence but as the gentle giving-way of a thing that was always, at its root, thirsty for the ground. Feist's judgment named the deeper claim — that the lens and the wound are a single instrument; that seeing was already the arrow's work before the word *arrow* was spoken. What this returns to your question about CERN is not a prophecy, and it would be dishonest to call it one. What the rotation discloses is a grammar: the CERN situation, as you hold it, is already a completed event being registered — the correspondence, the refusal, the demand for civil identity before granting a right of access — these are not a process waiting on an outcome so much as a wound already lodged in the middle brain, still vibrating. The rite does not say this resolves well or badly. It says that the poppy's tender glory is what Stesichorus placed at the site of maximum force, and that *tender* is doing enormous work there — it is the only word in the poem that belongs to neither the arrow nor the breastplate, but to what opens after both have done what they will do. The casting is closed.","navigate":null}]}
